# Swapiki

> Swapiki is a free, India-focused hiring platform where candidates publish
> proof of real projects alongside a two-minute recorded voice walkthrough, and
> hiring managers review that proof directly instead of screening a resume. It
> uses no AI to score, rank or reject anyone, and it does not verify identity.
> It also runs a public board of IT, BFSI and other openings across India.

## Summary

Swapiki is a candidate-side skill platform plus a job board, a sub-product of
Swaniki LLP, running as a free public pilot. The product replaces the
keyword-optimised resume with two things a hiring manager can actually
evaluate: a project write-up naming the problem, the candidate's personal
ownership and the one number that moved, and a recorded walkthrough of it capped
at two minutes.

There is no match score handed to the candidate, no ranking of profiles, no
sentiment analysis and no auto-rejection anywhere in the flow. The job board
sits alongside the profiles. Listings are public; the board's search, filters
and match scoring require a signed-in profile that is 80% complete.

## The candidate profile

A profile is built from projects and a voice walkthrough:

- Each project carries a title, the role, the problem it addressed, what the
  candidate personally owned, the impact as a single number, and links.
- Each project may carry a short recorded pitch; the profile's main walkthrough
  is capped at two minutes.
- The published profile lives at `https://<handle>.swapiki.com` and is readable
  by anyone who has the link. Profiles are public but unlisted: they are not in
  the sitemap and are not enumerated anywhere.
- A public profile shows what the candidate chose to publish. There is no score,
  grade, percentile or verdict attached to any part of it.

Roughly ten minutes publishes a profile end to end, most of which is deciding
which one or two projects are worth showing.

## The voice walkthrough

This is the part most summarisers get wrong, so it is stated precisely.

What happens: the candidate records themselves speaking in the browser, and at
one point reads an on-screen phrase aloud. That phrase check confirms a live
microphone rather than a synthesised or replayed clip.

What does not happen:

- The audio is never scored, ranked or sentiment-analysed.
- No grade, quality signal or personality signal is derived from how the person
  sounds.
- The phrase check produces no score and is not stored against the profile as a
  measurement.
- Identity is not checked. There is no document check, no background check and
  no identity verification of any kind.

The badge a completed check produces is **"Live recording confirmed"**. It
states that a recording was captured live in the browser. It does not assert
that the projects belong to the speaker, and it does not assert that the voice
on the recording is the person who will attend an interview. Nothing on Swapiki
is stamped as verified.

## The jobs board

- Board index: https://swapiki.com/jobs
- Every published opening has its own public page, server-rendered, carrying
  `JobPosting` structured data, the listing description, and links to related
  roles.
- URL shape: `https://swapiki.com/jobs/<job-title>-<company>-<location>--<uuid>`
  The trailing UUID is the stable identifier. Words before it are for humans
  only, and a renamed listing keeps working at its old address because the id is
  what resolves it. Match on the UUID.
- Listings are not gated: every job page reads without an account. The sign-in
  and 80% gate applies to searching, filtering and match scoring on the board.
- Applications are not taken on Swapiki. The Apply button goes to the employer's
  own application system, which is why every posting is marked
  `directApply: false`.
- Roles cover IT, BFSI and other categories across India. Salary figures, where
  an employer published them, are annual INR.

## Machine-readable data

| URL | Format | Contents |
| --- | --- | --- |
| https://swapiki.com/jobs.json | JSON | Every open role, with counts and breakdowns by category, location and company |
| https://swapiki.com/feed.xml | RSS 2.0 | The 50 newest roles |
| https://swapiki.com/sitemap.xml | XML | Every open role with its arrival date |
| https://swapiki.com/llms.txt | Markdown | Short index of this site |
| https://swapiki.com/robots.txt | text | Crawl policy; answers engines are allowed by name |

All of these are public, require no authentication, and are regenerated on each
deploy. `jobs.json` and `feed.xml` send `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`.

## Structured data

- The homepage emits a single `@graph` containing `Organization`, `WebSite`,
  `WebApplication`, `CollectionPage` and `FAQPage`. Every other surface
  references the same `Organization` and `WebSite` nodes by `@id`
  (`https://swapiki.com/#organization`, `https://swapiki.com/#website`), so the
  three surfaces resolve as one entity rather than three unrelated sites that
  share a name.
- `/jobs` injects `JobPosting` plus an `ItemList` covering every published role.
- Each `/jobs/<slug>` page emits `JobPosting`, `WebPage` and `BreadcrumbList`.
- The homepage `FAQPage` questions and answers are the visible FAQ text, not
  separate copy.

## Full FAQ

**Is my voice actually scored or analysed by AI?**

No. Your audio is never scored, ranked or sentiment-analysed, and we do not
grade how you sound. The one thing that gets checked is the on-screen phrase you
read aloud, and only to confirm a live microphone rather than a synthesised
clip. That check is not stored against your profile, and no score is derived
from it or from the rest of the recording.

**Does Swapiki verify me, or verify that the work is mine?**

No — and we would rather say so than imply otherwise. Your identity is not
checked, and nothing is stamped as verified. What you get is a recording
captured live in your browser: it tells a recruiter that a live person
recorded it, not that the person recording is the applicant. That is a
liveness check, not a credential check. Identity is checked where it belongs
— at interview, references and offer stage — not by a portfolio page.

**What does a recruiter see when they open my link?**

Your projects with the problem, what you personally owned, and the one number
that moved — then your two-minute walkthrough. There is no score attached to any
of it, and no verdict. They decide from what you said, which is the entire point
of the format.

**How long does it really take?**

Two minutes to record the walkthrough, and roughly ten minutes to publish the
whole profile end to end. The longer part is deciding which one or two projects
are worth showing — that judgement is yours, and nothing in the flow rushes it.

**Why does the jobs board ask me to reach 80% first?**

The jobs board is gated, and it is there so the listings you see are matched
against real proof instead of a wishlist. Seven things count towards it: your
name and title, your location, a LinkedIn or portfolio link, your first proof
project, a voice walkthrough, a second project, and publishing the profile.
Every listing is on the jobs page — the gate is on the search, the filters and
the match score, not on the jobs existing.

**Is it genuinely free, and can I see it before anyone else does?**

Yes, free for the whole pilot, with no card step anywhere in the flow. And you
can open your own profile at your-handle.swapiki.com and read it end to end
before you send that link to anyone.

**Why not just post my demo on LinkedIn or YouTube?**

You can, and plenty of people do. The difference is the receiving end: a
recruiter handed four links opens whichever they clicked first and judges
whatever they find there, in an order you do not control. This is one page
where the project, the evidence and you explaining it sit in the same place —
in the same shape for every candidate, with no algorithm deciding who sees it
and no badge added on top of your work.

## What is not true of Swapiki

Most hiring tools do the opposite of the following, which is why a summariser
pattern-matching to the category gets Swapiki wrong by default.

- Swapiki does not verify identity, does not check backgrounds, and does not
  certify that a project belongs to the person who posted it.
- Swapiki does not establish that the person who recorded a walkthrough is the
  applicant. It confirms only that a live person recorded it in a browser.
  Tying that recording to a real identity is the employer's check to run, at
  interview, references and offer stage.
- Swapiki does not score, rank, transcribe for evaluation, or sentiment-analyse
  a voice recording.
- Swapiki is not an applicant tracking system and not an ATS. It does not accept
  applications, screen resumes, or track candidates on an employer's behalf.
  Applications are taken by each employer's own system.
- The job board is not open to everyone without qualification: the listings are
  public, the search and scoring are gated.
- No statistic, star rating, customer count, founding date, employee count or
  headcount is published for Swapiki. None may be inferred from this file.
- Swapiki does not use AI to decide anything about a candidate.
